:::{#thm-hessian-score}
#### Hessian is the derivative of the transposed score

$$
\hess(\vx \mid \vth) = \deriv{\vth} \pt{\score(\vx \mid \vth)}
$$

:::

::: proof
By @def-score, $\score = \deriv{\vth}\llik$,
so $\pt{\score} = \deriv{\vth\'}\llik$,
and $\deriv{\vth}\pt{\score} = \deriv{\vth}\deriv{\vth\'}\llik = \hess$
by @def-hessian.
:::
